content.short: LlamaLend lets users borrow ETH by collateralizing smaller NFT collections outside the main markets.
content.description: LlamaLend enables users to borrow ETH by collateralizing smaller NFT collections outside the main markets. The interest rate is fixed at loan creation and is determined by pool utilization rates. When the NFT is pledged, one-third of its value is provided in ETH. Borrowers have two weeks to repay the loan and are charged interest only for the time used.
